Context: Medical claims requiring opinion of specialists

CGHS Medical Officer/Government Specialist shall not refer the beneficiaries to any particular diagnostic laboratory or imaging centre by name but, shall specify the investigation and mention  
'referred to CGHS empanelled centre'. - OM, dated 1-1-2013.
